pull.title: test: add BIP352 scanning to the functional test framework
pull.body: Picked from #35302 as an isolated change that can be evaluated independently. This should make #35302 a bit easier to review. This adds a Python implementation of BIP352 scanning, without labels, so the functional tests can check silent payments outputs independently of `bitcoind` support. It is tested against the BIP352 receiving test vectors.

+from io import BytesIO

+K_MAX = 2323
+P2TR_PREFIX = b"\x51\x20"

+P2SH_P2WPKH_SCRIPT_SIG_PREFIX = b"\x16" + P2WPKH_PREFIX
+P2PKH_PREFIX = b"\x76\xa9\x14"
+P2PKH_SUFFIX = b"\x88\xac"
+ANNEX_TAG = b"\x50"
+
+
+def get_input_pubkey(script_sig: bytes, witness: list[bytes], prevout_spk: bytes) -> GE | None:
+    """Return the public key of an input as a group element, or None if the input is not eligible."""
+    if len(prevout_spk) == 34 and prevout_spk[:2] == P2TR_PREFIX:
+        stack = list(witness)
+        if len(stack) > 1 and stack[-1][:1] == ANNEX_TAG:
+            _ = stack.pop()

+            return None
+        return GE.from_bytes_xonly(prevout_spk[2:])
+    if len(prevout_spk) == 22 and prevout_spk[:2] == P2WPKH_PREFIX:
+        if witness and len(witness[-1]) == 33:
+            return GE.from_bytes(witness[-1])
+        return None

+        if script_sig[:3] == P2SH_P2WPKH_SCRIPT_SIG_PREFIX and len(script_sig) == 23 and witness and len(witness[-1]) == 33:
+            return GE.from_bytes(witness[-1])
+        return None

+        for i in range(len(script_sig), 32, -1):
+            pubkey = script_sig[i - 33:i]
+            if hash160(pubkey) == prevout_spk[3:23]:
+                return GE.from_bytes(pubkey)
+    return None
+
+

Isn't this an issue when the output is in a transaction that is confirmed? getrawtransaction will return confirmed tx too when tx index is enabled.

I can include an old payment, and you may think it's a new payment during this scan, so you want to check the utxo set and getmempool entry or gate and only return the output when getmempool entry also returns the tx?

+        return None

+        if script_sig[:3] == P2SH_P2WPKH_SCRIPT_SIG_PREFIX and len(script_sig) == 23 and witness and len(witness[-1]) == 33:
+            return GE.from_bytes(witness[-1])
+        return None
+    if len(prevout_spk) == 25 and prevout_spk[:3] == P2PKH_PREFIX and prevout_spk[23:] == P2PKH_SUFFIX:

comments.body:
> getrawtransaction will return confirmed tx too

This is by design. We check for confirmed payments here as well, whose inputs will inherently not be in the UTXO set. See [this commit](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35302/changes/6cbb0ea9dc96cf4ab4a225a4d97e2dae70369b05) for the use cases. FWIW, a "real" scanner would use the undo data and block rather than `-txindex` and `getrawtransaction`.

Side note related to thsee calls, either we assume `-txindex` is enabled as is done here, or the user has to pass a block hash they expect the payment to be in, which would be cumbersome for writing tests IMO.
